dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Hello there. If you're lost, please turn back. Some of the rooms here are restricted access only.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What rooms are there in here?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: If I were to tell you, you'd get curious, so it might be best if I simply don't.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette's office is just over by the side — this much everyone knows.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: And, well... Lady Furina lives on the top floor. She's a real celebrity, so she really doesn't have any time slots free.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: But not to worry, the Maison Gardiennage and the Marechaussee Phantom are also upstairs, so anyone with ill intent will not be getting very far regardless.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, I'll be heading back now...

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Alright. Don't get any ideas, now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Neuvillette...

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette's time slots... No, his schedule, is also very full. He can't always be found in his office, in any case.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: If you have a matter to put before him, please submit an application to the corresponding Gestionnaire, according to the matter at hand.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Lady Furina...

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: There is a special entrance that leads to her suite which isn't accessible from here. If you really wanted to get there, you can try jumping off the roof.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Someone did once try to do this. Fortunately, his life didn't wind up in any danger — he is presently hard at work at the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What rooms are there in here?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: If I were to tell you, you'd get curious, so it might be best if I simply don't.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Monsieur Neuvillette's office is just over by the side — this much everyone knows.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: What else? The Maison Gardiennage and the Marechaussee Phantom are also upstairs, so anyone with ill intent will not be getting very far regardless.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Lady Furina...

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Are you asking where Lady Furina lives?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: She used to have an apartment on the top floor. I remember someone did once try to get in there by jumping off the roof.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Fortunately, his life didn't wind up in any danger — he is presently hard at work at the Fortress of Meropide.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Anyway, that kind of thing won't happen again. Lady Furina left her official post to pursue a life closer to her own desires.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: She seemed a lot more relaxed last time I saw her, so I don't think you need to worry about her.
